name: form-dialog
title: Form dialog
description: A dialog that is a form: Enter submits, buttons lock while it saves, closing is blocked mid-save and a failed save keeps everything typed.
docs: Pass the fields as children, each with a name, and an onSubmit that gets the FormData and may return a promise. Native validation runs first. While the promise is pending the fields, Cancel and the close button are disabled, Escape and the backdrop do nothing, and the save button stays focusable and says it is busy. A rejection puts its message in an alert at the top of the body and keeps everything typed; a resolution closes the dialog and focus returns to the trigger (pass trigger, or focus goes back to whatever had it). Focus starts on the first field. With dirtyGuard, closing a changed form asks "Discard changes?" in the footer, with Keep editing focused; changes are found by comparing the named fields with what they held when the dialog opened. open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange control it from outside. labels translates the words.
